body: I am pronounced as one letter, written with three. I come in blue, black, brown, or grey. Reverse me and I read the same either way. What am I?
I am put on a table, cut but never eaten?
I am quick when I'm thin. I am slow when I'm fat. Wind is my worst nightmare. What am I?
I am rarely touched but often held and if you are smart you'll use me well. What am I?
I am round as a bowl, deep as a tub but all the worlds water couldnt fill me up?
I am round or oval. I can be light or dark. You can cut me in pieces. What am I?
I am round. I have only one line. Circle is not my name indeed. What am I?
I am rubber you can eat! What am I?
I am running all the time but never get tired or hot. What am I?
I am seen in the water and in the sky. I am in the rainbow and a jay's feather. What am I?
I am seen in the water. If seen in the sky, I am in the rainbow, a jay's feather and lapis lazuli?
I am seen in the water. If seen in the sky, I am in the rainbow, a jay's feather and lapis lazuli. What am I?
I am set in white but colored myself. I have no words but I reveal much. What am I?

I am slim and tall, many find me desirable and appealing, they touch me and I give a false good feeling, once I shine in splendor but only once and then no more, for many I am "to die for". What am I?
I am small but, when entire, of force to set a town on fire; Let but one letter disappear, I then can hold a herd of deer; Take one more off and then you'll find I once contained all human kind?
I am so delicious that I require a house to contain me. What am I?
I am so simple that I can only point, yet I guide people all over the world?
I am so simple that I can only point. Yet I guide men all over the world?
I am soldier and I really hate one month. Which month I am talking about?
I am some one you don't know. Who am i?
I am something many people don't enjoy having as a friend, including you. But I am called upon anything someone is injured?
I am something that floats. But after a period of time I fall. What am I?
I am sometimes referred to as chips. What am I?
I am sometimes white but usually black. I take you there but I never bring you back. What am I?
I am sometimes yellow and sometimes white. Half of me is dark and the other is light. What am I?
I am taken from a mine and shut up in a wooden case, from which I am never released and yet I am used by almost everybody?
I am ten little beans your look at everyday. What am I?
I am the beginning of eternity, the end of time and space, the beginning of every end, the end of every place. What am I?
I am the beginning of everything, the end of everywhere. I'm the beginning of eternity, the end of time and space. What am I?
I am the beginning of everything, the end of everywhere. I’m the beginning of eternity, the end of time and space. What am I?

I am the beginning of sorrow and the end of sickness. You cannot express happiness without me, yet I am in the midst of crosses. I am always in risk, yet never in danger. You may find me in the sun but I am never seen out of darkness?
I am the beginning of the end and the end of time and space. I am essential to creation and I surround every place. What am I?
I am the best thing that can happen after a stick hits a ball. What am I?

I am the black child of a white father, a wingless bird, flying even to the clouds of heaven. I give birth to tears of mourning in pupils that meet me, even though there is no cause for grief and at once on my birth I am dissolved into air. What am I?
I am the book one can never finish reading. What am I?
I am the building with the most number of stories. What am I?
I am the fastest animal but cannot climb the tree. What am I?
I am the fountain from which no one can drink. For many I am considered a necessary link. Like gold to all I am sought for but my continued death brings wealth for all to want more?
I am the heart that does not beat. If cut, I bleed without blood. I can fly but have no wings. I can float but have no fins. I can sing but have no mouth?
I am the hole in the night, the ever watchful eye. I return in a cycle, to enlighten the sky?
I am the home for feathery animals. What am I?
I am the key that is the hardest to turn What am I?
I am the killer of trees but people need me. I can be blown away by a breeze and I have been here since ancient Greece. What am I?
I am the kind of ant that's good at math. What am I?
I am the kind of dog that chases anything red. What am I?
I am the kind of fish that chases a mouse. What am I?
I am the kind of food monkey likes and people slip on me and fall in cartoons. What am I?
I am the kind of nut that is empty at the center and has no shell. What am I?
I am the kind of soda you must not drink. What am I?
I am the minerals vital for your good health. What am I?
